parsed.summary: The drawing is a coherent ATtiny-driven fan controller: dual MCU footprints (U1 ATtiny45-20P THT / U2 ATtiny13V-10S SMD) wired in parallel, a potentiometer input (J9->PB3), a PMOS/NPN high-side fan switch (Q2/Q1) on J7, an AVR-ISP-6 header whose MISO/MOSI/SCK/RST map correctly to PB1/PB0/PB2/PB5, decoupling caps, a 5V1 clamp, and a configurable VCC/+5V power scheme with a regulator and jumper option. The parallel footprints and switchable/bridged power rails match the repository author's documented convention (SMD+THT compatible footprints, FET/jumper-switchable VIN seen on the 18650 board), and no passive sits in the wrong position or carries an out-of-role value, so I find no deviation that would change the board's behaviour.
